title: Visa Signature cards are now available in your Oxen account - Oxen
subject: Visa Signature cards are now available in your Oxen account
intro: Visa Signature cards are now available in your Oxen space. You manage them directly from your account.
s1_body: You can assign physical or virtual cards to your employees. Virtual cards can be used online as soon as they are created.
s2_body: You add funds once, at company level, and every card uses the same card balance.
s3_body: Open the Cards section, create a card and add funds from your euro account. Cards run in US dollars: the euros you add are converted to USD when you top up.
s4_body: Choose a minimum balance and a reload amount, and your card balance refills from your euro account.
tip_body: At checkout, choose to pay in the local currency rather than in your card's currency.
issuer_text: The Oxen Spend Card is issued by Nimbus LLC dba Third National, pursuant to a licence from Visa. The card programme is managed by Rain.
